Estira els extrems fins que el centre queda molt més prim i s’obre una esquerda transversal.

continuity.anchor: Un cordó en dos trossos, cap porció afegida ni perduda.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic monkey; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un cordó curt de plastilina bicolor és sencer. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Estira els extrems fins que el centre queda molt més prim i s’obre una esquerda transversal. RIGHT result: Les mans mostren dues parts amb l’estrenyiment repartit entre les dues vores. Continuity and accounting: Un cordó en dos trossos, cap porció afegida ni perduda. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image.
attempts.review: El nombre de voltes de color augmenta en estirar el cordó i hi ha una altra peça aparent de plastilina a la taula. La imatge ha de permetre seguir una sola porció i els dos fragments que en resulten.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Flat 2D children’s educational drawing using clear shapes, solid colors and dark clean outlines, of one recognizable anthropomorphic monkey; same ears, tail and functional paws throughout. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un cordó curt de plastilina bicolor és sencer. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Estira els extrems fins que el centre queda molt més prim i s’obre una esquerda transversal. RIGHT result: Les mans mostren dues parts amb l’estrenyiment repartit entre les dues vores. Continuity and accounting: Un cordó en dos trossos, cap porció afegida ni perduda. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Specific production fix: Correct this previously rejected feature: El nombre de voltes de color augmenta en estirar el cordó i hi ha una altra peça aparent de plastilina a la taula. La imatge ha de permetre seguir una sola porció i els dos fragments que en resulten. Single bicolor purple/yellow modeling clay cable with exactly THREE wide twists only. Nothing else on the table. The ends are pulled apart horizontally, center thins then shows small fresh crack. The cable breaks in exactly 2 halves, preserving the very same three stripes across BOTH parts altogether. No extra clay, containers or objects on the table.
attempts.review: Les mans estiren en sentits contraris. La torsió s’aplana, s’hi obre un estrip i es mantenen els dos fragments del mateix material bicolor.
